title: A line priced through Same as previous tier is in the customer's tier row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is Markup % 20.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is Same as previous tier.
  • Note that tiers A and B are made one right after the other with no other tier made in between, so tier B is the number right after tier A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, put on tier B for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $120.00 through tier B, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Pick customer B in the Customer filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 2:

  • Tier B's row reads Parts Invoiced $120.00 ($100.00 × 1.20, tier A's rule).
  • Tier A has no row.
